stages.name: compute
stages.message: Loaded 12 rows (9 scored, 3 zero_output). Computed cost_per_found (4 real, 8 no-data), recall_per_minute (12/12 real), and agent-level reliability aggregates. Written to chart_data.json.

stages.name: render
stages.message: All 5 charts rendered. recall_vs_field_accuracy.png used an inset-zoom layout for the dense 8-point cluster (95-100% recall x 98-100% field accuracy) plus jitter+leader-lines for exact-duplicate coordinates (3 zero_output runs at (0,0); a 4-way tie and a 2-way tie inside the cluster). recall_vs_runtime.png passed the plain adjustText layout on the first attempt with no inset needed. Both scatter charts passed the overlap and 12%-locality gates before saving.

stages.name: evaluation
stages.message: All charts use only the specified palette (#fcfcfb/#0b0b0b/#52514e/#e1e0d9/#c3c2b7 chart ink, #2a78d6 claude-code, #eb6834 opencode, #d03b3b failure red). No dual-axis, pie, or 3D charts. Legends present on all multi-series charts. Every per-run chart (recall_vs_field_accuracy, recall_vs_runtime, cost_per_found_study, recall_per_minute) labels all 12 combinations individually with zero overlapping labels, programmatically verified.

stages.name: report_generation
stages.message: chart_data.json, summary.md, and validation_report.json all written to /app/results.

deviations: Input CSV has 9 scored / 3 zero_output rows, not the runbook's generic 8/4 split; all computations and charts reflect the actual 12-row dataset.

recall_vs_field_accuracy.png required an inset-zoom layout (per the runbook's own fallback procedure) because 8 of 12 points cluster inside a ~5%x2% region of the axes -- plain adjustText could not have separated all 8 labels legibly at that density.
